newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize up in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize up in tight trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize firmed in tight trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices squeezed up by recent rains slowing the harvest and also a firm Chicago, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Buenos Aires firmed $2 to $112. Spot soybeans firmed $5 to $293 in Rosario, largely following Chicago but also influenced by the rain slowing harvest delivery. Spot sunflower seed firmed $4 to $216 in Buenos Aires in moderate volume, with plenty of demand from cruchers. Spot Bahia Blanca wheat wsa unchanged at $156 in slow trade.
